question:
Read the following passage carefully and answer the questions that follow by selecting the most appropriate option from the given alternatives.

Artificial Intelligence (AI) is gradually transforming the way students learn. From virtual tutors to personalized learning paths, Al helps identify each learner's strengths and weaknesses. With the help of data, Al systems can suggest specific topics where student
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage highlights that while AI supports learning, it also raises **concerns about data privacy**.
 
• Student performance data being stored online may lead to misuse, leakage, or unauthorized access.
 
• This is an important issue because education-related personal information is sensitive and must be protected.
 
• Other options like **attendance drops, internet speed, and exam cheating** are not discussed in the passage.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3 – Data Privacy**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Data Privacy:** Refers to the protection of personal information from misuse or unauthorized access.
 
• **Example:** If schools do not secure their AI systems, hackers could steal student grades, personal details, or exam data.
 
• Thus, ensuring data security is essential when adopting AI in education.
